RecorderManager.onResume(function listener)

Listen to the recording resume event. At this time, the recorder enters the recording state again. This event can be triggered only by RecorderManager.resume()(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Parameter

function listener

Listening function of the recording resume event

Sample Code

Page({
    onload() {
        recorderManager.onResume(() => {
            ma.showToast({
                title: 'onResume',
                icon: 'success',
                duration: 500
            });
        });
    }
})
